research_name: 上帝源碼 G28-CFF：AI 計算自由場之有限開放式假說搜尋
claim: Finite, deterministic, reproducible diversity-oriented generation of structured untested hypotheses under explicit budgets and permissions

relationship_to_prior_versions.G22_G23: not modified; no original Turing-machine replay claimed
relationship_to_prior_versions.G26: exact symbolic-log arithmetic may be integrated in a future separately tested adapter; not in this prototype
relationship_to_prior_versions.G27: not modified; external domain evidence not imported or authenticated
relationship_to_prior_versions.previous_G28_research_acceleration_propo: This is the hypothesis-exploration component; no real experimental acceleration is established

quality_diversity_archive: One elite hypothesis per (domain, cost band) cell; replace only when metadata-proxy score increases
novelty: Minimum Hamming distance over four hypothesis identifiers relative to current elites
random_comparator: Randomly chosen, non-repeated proposals under equal proposed-hypothesis budget with same per-cell best-survivor policy
fairness_caveat: Guided search evaluates beam_width metadata lookaheads at each scored proposal; baseline evaluates one. Equal scored-proposal counts are not equal computing effort
repeated_benchmark: Thirty fixed seeds each for budgets 16,24,64; results stored as a completely synthetic JSON report; not a published independent replication
one_line_script_role: Independent, bounded, output-report consistency checker only; not a self-contained generator or source authenticator
limitations: A fixed combinatorial grammar cannot discover unrepresented mechanisms. Synthetic quality scores are not empirical evidence. No general intelligence, universal halting oracle, real-world outcomes or literal computational singularity is proved.
